_predictions.construction: the engine builds fewer levels than the script did: 25-80 levels by 1936 per healthy run (v3: 92-101); dam electricity 15-35% of the world at 1935 (v3: 43-44%)
_predictions.who: owners build in their own states; overlords build in their subjects' states in every run, but rarely (a handful of levels)
_predictions.stalls: some dam levels sit in poor owners' queues for years (F173's pattern) - no guard by ruling; counted, not fixed
_predictions.economy: world GDP inside the canon seed spread (0.68-1.04) in every run; no hard break attributable to the dams
_predictions.perf: play time within 5% of the canon on a quiet machine
